Package sc.fiji.snt.gui

Enum Class NodeEditCommand

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<NodeEditCommand>
sc.fiji.snt.gui.NodeEditCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<NodeEditCommand>, java.lang.constant.Constable
public enum NodeEditCommand extends Enum<NodeEditCommand>
Node-editing commands of 'Edit Mode': single source of truth for their labels, default shortcuts and enabled-state logic, so that every front-end (classic canvas, Bdv, Bvv) exposes the same menu and key bindings. The operations themselves live in PathNodeEditor; hosts only map a command to a call and supply the cursor position (see BigViewerEditor).
Author:
Tiago Ferreira

      public static void addMenuItems(JPopupMenu menu, NodeEditCommand.MenuState state, Consumer<NodeEditCommand> handler)
      Appends the node-editing commands to a menu, grouped by separators. Commands that are not applicable in the given state are disabled, not omitted
      Parameters:
      menu - the menu to be populated
      state - the editor state
